Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our agreement, I pulled together a path that lets CardinalHealth expand capacity mid-contract while aligning the renewal date (co-term) and minimizing your near-term cash impact. Attached: Cardinal_SOW_v3.pdf and uplift_pricing_model_v2.csv.

High level proposal — please review and tell me which option you'd prefer:

- Option A (co-term + modest uplift): 10% uplift for the next 12 months, co-term to 12/31/2027, $75k one-time onboarding credit to offset migration work.
- Option B (staggered uplift, phased billing): 6% uplift now, +5% after 90 days (net 11.3% effective over year), co-term stays aligned with current anniversary, invoice split across two quarters.
- Optional: Quarterly invoicing instead of annual if procurement requires (adds 1.5% processing fee).

We can also offer a step-down usage credit if usage drops below the baseline during the first 6 months — we included a conservative protection in the attached model.

Next steps: if Option A or B looks reasonable, I can route an updated SOW and a DocuSign link. If procurement wants a net-zero uplift trade (credits instead of percentage), flag it and I’ll loop legal.

Best,
Aditya Rao
